svg.title: One token's vector through the residual stream
svg.text: One token's vector after each layer: every layer adds a little, nothing is overwritten
Real values, last token of “The capital of France is”. Each column is the same vector one layer later:
the pattern carries over (each layer only adds to it), the size keeps growing, and read out as a word
it is noise until the additions turn it into “Paris” around layer 24.
